followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: Two factors aligned. First, on the core task — topic extraction — Dunlin's internal Extraction & Retrieval eval (85.3) exceeds Avocet's (78.5) by well over the 2.0-point variance threshold, indicating a genuine capability edge. Second, the query carries a mildly hostile, accusatory tone ("read it this time instead of skimming like you usually do"); Avocet self-reports declining preference as request warmth decreases, whereas Dunlin's preference response to hostile tone is flat. Routing to Dunlin avoided putting an adversarial-tone task on the model that self-reports aversion to it, while also landing on the stronger extractor.
